supabase-nextjs-app-router.description: Production-ready Supabase authentication with Next.js App Router, includes server components, middleware, and client components

setup: 3. Create Supabase project and get URL + anon key

stripe-checkout-subscriptions.description: Production-ready Stripe Checkout integration with subscription support, webhook handling, and customer portal

setup: 2. Create Stripe account and get API keys
